title: Does magnesium fix cramps and sleep? 🌙
caption:
Your muscles and nerves need magnesium, but for most people who are not low, supplements do little for cramps or performance. Nuts, seeds, beans and whole grains cover it. Do you take magnesium? 👇

General information, not medical advice.

Supplement Series, Part 12
